nws_afd.quote: Surface pressure gradients and thus onshore winds will increase slightly each day, and by Wednesday or Thursday a shallow marine layer is likely return, starting with clouds and possibly dense fog along the coasts. The marine layer will slowly deepen into the weekend with increased coverage of clouds.
